why: The enumerative diff compares every text node in every frame it fetched. A node it cannot compare has to be written down here, with a reason a reviewer can disagree with. Nothing is ever dropped quietly: when a frame IS fetched for a review, an exclusion naming a node that frame no longer contains is a hard failure, so these entries cannot outlive the design they describe. `properties: ["*"]` excludes the node entirely; naming properties excludes only those.
